{{Quote|Because I was his Master, I alone of the allied Jedi went to confront him, hoping that I could turn him back. I knew it was a foolish mission, but I had no choice. I had to try.|Vodo-Siosk Baas, about facing Exar Kun|<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>}}
In the year [[3996 BBY]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], a '''duel''' took place in the '''Senate Hall''' of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], between the [[Krevaaki]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vodo-Siosk Baas]] and his former [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]], now [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]. It commenced on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], in the Hall's [[Grand Convocation Chamber]], during the [[Trial of Ulic Qel-Droma|trial of]] Kun's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] and fellow [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]], [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]]. Accompanied by [[Mandalore the Indomitable]], Exar Kun arrived on Coruscant and stormed the [[Senate Hall]], where he found Ulic Qel-Droma on trial for crimes against the Republic. Using [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]], the Dark Lord [[Qâzoi Kyantuska|mentally froze]] the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] assembly, leaving only the present Jedi and the [[Sidrona|Supreme]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] uninhibited. After freeing Qel-Droma, he then accosted and killed the Chancellor and prepared to exit; however, the Sith were halted by the arrival of Kun's former teacher&mdash;Jedi Master Vodo-Siosk Baas.

Kun and Master Baas engaged in a heated verbal exchange, with neither willing to accept the other's terms. Kun then ignited his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] while issuing his challenge, and his blade met Baas' [[Master Vodo's quarterstaff|Force-imbued staff]] in battle. When it was realized that the opponents were evenly matched in combat, Kun sought to tip the balance in his favor by revealing his latest creation, a weapon of ancient Sith design: the [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]]. Baas' own mettle now faltering under the strength of Kun's blows, the Master sensed his impending demise as he [[Force vision/Legends|prophesied a future meeting]] between the two of them, where Baas vowed to defeat Kun forever. He then became one with the Force under the power of Kun's killing stroke, being mocked by his former apprentice even unto [[Death/Legends|death]]. His part in the bloody [[Sith uprising]] complete, the Dark Lord of the Sith departed the Convocation Chamber with Ulic Qel-Droma and Mandalore the Indomitable, resuming their quest for dominion over the galaxy.

==Prelude==
===The uprising begins===
{{Quote|What&hellip;what do you want me do, Exar? Am I supposed to&hellip;''kill'' Master Vodo?''"<br />"''No, Crado&hellip;go with Oss Wilum. He may need your help. Master Thon will be difficult. Leave Vodo to me&hellip;|[[Crado]], and Exar Kun|<ref name="TSW2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 2]]</ref>}}
[[The galaxy/Legends|The galaxy]]-wide [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] was a tumultuous ordeal for both the members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In the span of just a year and several months, the [[Brotherhood of the Sith|Brotherhood]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], led by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]], had steadily confounded both the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the Republic with defeats in battle. Kun next sought to [[Sith uprising|eliminate the Jedi leadership]], and charged his newly-initiated [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith converts]] with the task of murdering their [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]], a plot that was intended to culminate with the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Kun's own Master, [[Vodo-Siosk Baas]]. The new Sith then departed Kun's stronghold on the jungle-[[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin IV]], just as the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of [[Mandalore the Indomitable]] touched down, with the [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] rushing out to speak with the Dark Lord. He explained that the [[Battle of Coruscant (Great Sith War)|premature attack]] on the galactic capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by Kun's fellow [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] leader [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]], had gone awry. During the battle, Qel-Droma had been [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] in a [[Wall of light|wall of]] [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]]-side energy by the Jedi, and taken into custody by the [[Sidrona|Supreme]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] of the Galactic Republic. Determined to have the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|fallen Jedi]] [[Trial of Ulic Qel-Droma|tried]] for his war crimes against the galaxy, the only punishment proper in the Chancellor's mind for Qel-Droma was execution.<ref name="TSW2" />

Mandalore was determined to rescue the Krath [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]], and he sought Exar Kun's assistance to do it. However, the Dark Lord had previously warned Qel-Droma against a preemptive strike upon the galactic capital, and getting himself apprehended only validated Kun's prior notion. Nonetheless, he agreed to assist Mandalore, as Qel-Droma was still a vital factor in their cause. They boarded Kun's vessel, ''[[Starstorm One]]'', and set out to rescue their beleaguered comrade from the clutches of the Galactic Republic.<ref name="TSW2" />

===The trial of Qel-Droma===
{{Dialogue|Ulic|You'll have to kill me if you want to stop me.|Cay|I can't.|Baas|'''I''' will. But it is Exar Kun who must be stopped&hellip;not Ulic.|attr=Ulic Qel-Droma, Cay Qel-Droma, and Master Baas|src=<ref name="TSW3" />}}
[[File:VodoPressesExarKun.jpg|thumb|left|285px|Vodo-Siosk Baas confronts Exar Kun.]]
A cadre of Sith [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warriors accompanied Exar Kun and Mandalore the Indomitable as they burst through the doors of the Galactic [[Senate Hall]]. In the center of the [[Grand Convocation Chamber|Convocation Chamber]] was Ulic Qel-Droma, shackled and being judged by the entire [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] assembly, including the Supreme Chancellor of the Republic. Also present were Ulic's former allies: [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Nomi Sunrider]], [[Sylvar]], and his brother, [[Cay Qel-Droma]]. In the presence of the appalled Senate, the Dark Lord [[Telekinesis/Legends|freed]] Qel-Droma of his shackles through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and in another gesture, used his [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith powers]] to [[Qâzoi Kyantuska|mentally render the entire audience paralyzed]], save the present Jedi and the Chancellor. Exar Kun then ascended the podium in the center of the Chamber, but was attacked by the bewildered Chancellor, whose futile attempt to defend himself caused Kun to bore his fingers into the Chancellor's cranium and hold him aloft, while mentally forcing him to repeat Kun's words as though he were a puppet. The Chancellor mimicked Kun's speech as he laid out his plans for restoring the fabled [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], even as he denounced the Republic and professed its obsolescence in his grand design. Kun then dropped the dead Chancellor in a pool of his own blood before a captivated audience, and collected the exonerated Qel-Droma, Mandalore, and his Massassi, with intentions of leaving. It was then that the Sith were yet again waylaid by the arrival of Kun's former teacher, Vodo-Siosk Baas.<ref name="TSW3" />

The [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] Jedi Sylvar sought to battle Exar Kun in his stead, but Master Baas stopped her, and regarded his former student as his personal responsibility. Baas then demanded that Exar Kun cease his [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] practices, but Kun refused, and instead tempted Master Baas with the offer of a position within the newly-formed Sith Brotherhood. However, when the [[Krevaaki]] Jedi declared that he would never submit himself to Sith teachings, Kun activated his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. With all other options exhausted, Baas readied [[Master Vodo's quarterstaff|his staff]], and battle ensued.<ref name="TSW3" />

==The duel==
{{Quote|This is not the end, Exar Kun. You and I will fight again&hellip;perhaps not for a long time, But I will defeat you.''"<br />"''Words. Go on to your higher plane, teacher. The galaxy is mine now.|Vodo-Siosk Baas' last words with Exar Kun|<ref name="TSW3" />}}
[[File:Die_squidface_die.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Baas and Kun duel to the death.]]
Exar Kun remembered his previous loss against Baas' greater skill<ref name="DLOTS1">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 1|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 1]]</ref> as he battled relentlessly with his blue blade; Baas, however, dueled with his Force-imbued staff,<ref name="TSW3" /> ready to prove yet again that it was more than a match for any lightsaber.<ref name="DLOTSA">[[Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith'' audio drama]]</ref> All the while, the [[Senator/Legends|Senate assembly]] remained captivated by Exar Kun's spell, and the Jedi were halted by Mandalore and Kun's Massassi warriors. Master Baas was effortlessly holding his own against the Dark Lord, dismissing all Kun's taunts. Kun likewise refused Baas' pleas for surrender. Neither opponent gave any quarter under the strength of the other's blows, and try as he might, Vodo-Siosk Baas was unable to best Exar Kun, nor could he convince him to renounce the dark side and end his campaign of galactic destruction.<ref name="TSW3" />

Irritated by the Jedi Master's tireless begging, Exar Kun decided to take the contest up a notch. To Baas' surprise, Kun twisted his lightsaber hilt and produced from its opposite end an identical blue blade: he now dueled with a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]]. Master Baas was unprepared for the unique [[Melee weapon/Legends|weapon]], and the Sith took full advantage in raining down blows upon him. Baas' defenses could no longer withstand the assault; thus, he knew that the duel was already lost to him, and he humbled himself to the Force. He then told Exar Kun that he would some day defeat him, maybe not now, but ''one day'' and forever. Ignoring this proclamation, Exar Kun bade his former Master farewell and crashed the final blow down on him, cleaving his staff in two. There on the Senate floor, Vodo-Siosk Baas became one with the Force. Only his [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]] and the splintered wood of his cane remained.<ref name="TSW3" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|The Senate members may think they are running things, but they are only acting in a shadow play. We are tired of serving their weakness, and we will work toward our own ends from now on. The Sith Brotherhood controls the galaxy.|Exar Kun, Dark Lord of the Sith|<ref name="TSW3" />}}
Dark Lord of the Sith Exar Kun and his apprentice Ulic Qel-Droma strode triumphantly from the Senate Chamber with Mandalore and Massassi warriors following close behind. The Sith bid the assembly farewell and made their departure for Yavin IV, leaving Nomi Sunrider, Cay Qel-Droma, and Sylvar to cradle the robes and broken staff of Vodo-Siosk Baas in grief.<ref name="TSW3" />

Across the galaxy, Exar Kun's Sith servants were also attacking their respective Masters, striking them down to make way for the great Sith destiny foretold by Kun. With the threat of the Jedi Masters removed, the Brotherhood of the Sith resumed their campaign against the Republic, whom they intended to crush under the power of the dark side.<ref name="TSW4" />

==Legacy==
{{Dialogue|Baas|Together Jedi can overcome their weaknesses. Exar Kun, my student&mdash;you are defeated at last.|Kun|No!|Skywalker|Yes.|attr=The final defeat of Exar Kun|src=<ref name="Champions" />}}
Vodo Siosk-Baas' final words to Exar Kun did come to pass many thousands of years in the future. At the new [[Jedi Praxeum]] established in the [[Great Temple/Legends|Massassi temple]] on Yavin IV by Jedi Master [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], Kun's [[Force ghost/Legends|disembodied spirit]] began to harass Skywalker's [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainees]] with temptations of the dark side. However, when the students banded together to confront Kun, the ghost of Master Vodo-Siosk Baas appeared, and assisted the trainees in vanquishing Kun's spirit forever.<ref name="Champions">''[[Champions of the Force]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The duel in the Senate Hall was written and conceived by author [[Kevin J. Anderson]] for the fifth [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Tales of the Jedi'']] story arc entitled [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War|''The Sith War'']]. First appearing in the comic issue [[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 3|''The Trial of Ulic Qel-Droma'']] of ''The Sith War'' arc, the duel saw the first death in Kun's Jedi "uprising" scheme. Anderson thus used the duel to both kill off the character of Vodo-Siosk Baas, and also to reunite the characters of Ulic Qel-Droma and Exar Kun, a union that began in the final issue of Anderson's [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - Dark Lords of the Sith'']] story arc, a joint project with fellow author [[Tom Veitch]].

''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' mistakenly places Vodo-Siosk Baas's death at the hands of Exar Kun as during the [[Conclave at Deneba|Conclave on Deneba]].<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> There are entries that state correctly that it took place on Coruscant, however.<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia 1">{{CSWECite|I||Galactic Senate Chamber}}</ref><ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia 2">{{CSWECite|II||Lightstaff}}</ref>
